assets.name: 灰绿抹灰墙 · 连续墙顶
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular wall texture for 潮汐线, muted post-flood pixel-art salvage game. The supplied classic-game screenshots are reference for readable roofless walls and architectural volume ONLY; do not recreate any screenshot, building or scene. Existing crate is reference for crisp pixel size, muted colors and fixed upper-left light. Original design. Hard-edged coarse pixel art, small restrained palette, no photographic noise, no antialiasing, no text, no objects, no cast shadow, no vignette, no floor. Create ONE full-bleed square seamlessly repeatable TOP CAP material only for a thick old masonry wall seen from a high 75-degree overhead orthographic camera. Warm grey-green cut stone / worn cement cap, broad quiet pixel clusters with very few weathered chips, subtly lighter than a grey-green floor. NO brick grid, NO face or bevel inside this square, NO outline or border. Continuous surface, no obvious central motif. Main medium grey-sage around #929384, restrained dark #6c756b and light #a3a494. This top material will be joined to separately drawn dark vertical face strips by renderer. Image filled to every edge, fully opaque. Target logical32x32 texture.
assets.processing: nearest-neighbour native-size sampling; 16-color quantization; joining-edge pixel pairing

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular wall texture for 潮汐线, muted post-flood pixel-art salvage game. Create ONE horizontally seamless rectangular FRONT VERTICAL FACE strip for a thick old plastered masonry wall. Canvas aspect ratio8:3, target32x12 logical pixels. This is the visible south-facing wall face, NOT a top-down floor texture. Full rectangular flat material strip: narrow light grey-green stone coping lip along the top (one logical pixel), below it a visibly darker desaturated sage-grey PLASTER face, a sparse pair of exposed mortar blocks beneath chipped plaster near lower part, then a narrow darker stone footing along bottom two logical pixels. Horizontal lines level, vertical edges seamless with no end pillars, no side bevels, no perspective converging edges. Top lip around #929384, plaster #666f64, shadow #394b43. Broad solid color planes, only sparse tiny chips; not a noisy field. No windows, no door, no vines, no signs, no scene. All canvas opaque, no padding. Must read as an architectural vertical face even when reduced to32x12.
